locale.title: Zoonies: Escape from Makatu
locale.synopsis:
Join the exciting adventures of Leo the tiny lion as his Sunday afternoon flight suddenly ends with a spear through his engine!
Evil shaman Makatu and his savage tribe of Tuba warriors chase Leo to trap him forever. Only YOU can help him find his way back to friends and family.
Solve puzzles and defeat enemies in this unique and original puzzle platformer.
Most importantly: Keep Running!

locale.title: Zuma's Revenge!
locale.synopsis:
Play the ribbeting, ball-blasting sequel - now on Nintendo DSiWare!
An irresistible force has taken our fearless frog to a newly evolved world of Zuma, ruled by evil tiki bosses.
Fire stone spheres to destroy the deadly stream of balls in this PopCap, ball-blasting challenge on Nintendo DSiWare!
Conquer over 60 adventure levels and battle six imposing tiki bosses. Leap into the all-new Daily Dungeon and take a shot at three daily challenges. Slide and hop for smarter shots, hit targets for exotic bonuses and detonate explosive power-up balls. Will you succumb to the perilous pitfalls, or can you tame the jungle and guide your agile amphibian to victory?

locale.title: Zuma's Revenge!
locale.synopsis:
Play the ribbeting, ball-blasting sequel - now on Nintendo DSiWare!
An irresistible force has taken our fearless frog to a newly evolved world of Zuma, ruled by evil tiki bosses.
Fire stone spheres to destroy the deadly stream of balls in this PopCap, ball-blasting challenge on Nintendo DSiWare!
Conquer over 60 adventure levels and battle six imposing tiki bosses. Leap into the all-new Daily Dungeon and take a shot at three daily challenges. Slide and hop for smarter shots, hit targets for exotic bonuses and detonate explosive power-up balls. Will you succumb to the perilous pitfalls, or can you tame the jungle and guide your agile amphibian to victory?

locale.title: Zuma's Revenge!
locale.synopsis:
Disfruta en Nintendo DSi de la explosiva secuela de nuestra rana favorita. Una poderosa fuerza ha arrastrado a nuestra valiente ranita a un nuevo mundo de Zuma que vive bajo el yugo de malvados jefes tiki.
Dispara esferas pétreas para detener la mortífera cadena de bolas en este entretenido juego de PopCap para Nintendo DSi.
Conquista más de 60 niveles del modo Aventura y combate contra seis imponentes jefes tiki. Salta de lleno al novedoso Daily Dungeon donde cada día encontrarás tres retos distintos. Salta de un sitio a otro, deslízate hacia mejores ubicaciones para disparar mejor, obtener exóticos bonus y detonar explosivas magias. ¿Sucumbirás a esta mágica selva o acaso te alzarás como triunfante guía de esta ágil rana?

locale.title: Tales to Enjoy! Little Red Riding Hood
locale.synopsis:
Each book is filled with features to entertain children while helping them to learn and stimulate their imagination. The game is a series of interactive activities based around the theme of the story about a little girl who decides to visit her grandmother who lives in the forest. Beware you may shout…. of the wolf who is looking upon Little Red Riding Hood as a main course for his next meal!
- An easy to use interface allows the youngest of children to navigate through choices as the entire interface is voice-over guided. - In one of the modes "Tell your own tale," children can animate all objects in the story world and either tell the story or invent one of their own. - Increasing difficulty of the minigames - Interactive classic story - Voice-over guided interface and storytelling for the youngest children - Studio recorded voice over’s with professional actors

locale.title: Zombie Skape
locale.synopsis:
Ethan was Skateboarding in the park as usual.
He practiced a lot every evening. His dream was to become number 1, and imitate his great idol "Johnny Eagle", the best skater of all times.
One night, as he practiced, something strange was happening... Without knowing why, Ethan was surrounded by lots of Zombies. It was a nightmare. Now he will have to put everything he has learned through Skateboarding into practice to survive.
Arcade game with a terrifying atmosphere. Learn to use the Skateboard to survive. Rescue as many girls as possible. Loads of Zombies onscreen. Ranking to compete against friends.

locale.title: Zombie Skape
locale.synopsis:
Comme à son habitude, Ethan s'exerçait dans le parc avec sa planche à roulettes. Il s'entraînait beaucoup toutes les après-midi. Son rêve était de devenir le numéro 1, et d'émuler son idole “Jonny Eagle”, le meilleur patineur de tous les temps.
Un soir, alors qu'il s'entraînait, quelque chose d'étrange arriva... sans savoir pourquoi, Ethan découvrit qu'il était entouré d'un grand nombre de Zombies, c'était un cauchemar. Maintenant, pour survivre, il faudra mettre en pratique toute l'expérience acquise avec le skateboard.
Jeu électronique dans un environnement terrifiant. Apprends à utiliser la planche à roulettes pour survivre. Sauve autant de filles que possible. Grand nombre de zombies à l'écran. Classement pour rivaliser avec les amis.

Juego Arcade con ambientación terrorífica. Aprende a usar el SkateBoard para sobrevivir. Rescata a todas las chicas posibles. Gran cantidad de Zombies en pantalla. Ranking para competir con amigos.

locale.title: Zombie Skape
locale.synopsis:

Er übt jeden Abend stundenlang, damit sein Traum irgendwann wahr wird – Nummer 1 zu sein, genauso wie sein großes Vorbild „Johnny Eagle“, der beste Skateboarder aller Zeiten.
Eines Nachts, als er wieder einmal übt, passiert etwas Seltsames... Ohne zu wissen, wie ihm geschieht, ist Ethan von einer großen Gruppe Zombies umzingelt – ein Alptraum.
Jetzt ist der Moment gekommen, in dem er alle seine bisherigen Skaterfähigkeiten einsetzen muss, um zu überleben.

- Lerne, das Skateboard zu nutzen, um zu überleben.

locale.title: Zombie Skape
locale.synopsis:
Si allenava molto ogni pomeriggio. Il suo sogno era quello di essere il numero uno e imitare il suo grande idolo "Johnny Eagle", il miglior skater di tutti i tempi.
Una notte, durante un allenamento, accadde qualcosa di strano... senza sapere perché, Ethan si ritrovò circondato da un sacco di zombie. Gli sembrava di essere in un incubo.
Ora dovrà mettere in pratica tutto ciò che ha imparato con lo skateboard per poter sopravvivere.
- Gioco arcade con ambientazione terrificante.
- Impara a usare lo skateboard per sopravvivere.
- Porta in salvo le ragazze.

locale.title: Zombie Skape
locale.synopsis:
Zoals gewoonlijk was Ethan aan het skaten in het park.
Hij trainde elke avond. Zijn grootste droom was om nummer 1 te worden en zijn idool “Johnny Eagle”, de beste skater aller tijden, te imiteren.
Op een avond terwijl hij aan het trainen was gebeurde er iets vreemds.
Zonder te weten waarom werd Ethan plots omringd door heel veel zombies. Het was een nachtmerrie!
Nu moet hij een beroep doen op al zijn skatevaardigheden om te overleven.
- Speelhalspel met een angstaanjagende atmosfeer.
- Leer je skateboard te gebruiken om te overleven.
- Bevrijd zoveel mogelijk meisjes.
- Heel veel zombies om het scherm.
- Lokale ranglijsten om het op te nemen tegen vrienden.

locale.title: Zombie Skape
locale.synopsis:

Uma noite, enquanto treinava, passou-se algo estranho... Sem saber porquê, Ethan viu-se rodeado por uma grande quantidade de Zombies. Era um pesadelo.
Agora tens que pôr em prática tudo o que ele aprendeu a praticar Skate para sobreviveres.
-Jogo de arcada com um ambiente assustador.
-Aprende a usar o Skate para sobreviveres.
-Salva todas as meninas que conseguires.

-Lista de classificação local para competires com amigos.

locale.title: Fizz
locale.synopsis: In FIZZ, you earn points by creating rings of energy. To do that, you must align identical colors and create links between the different nodes. The bigger your rings, the more points you earn. There will be outside events that get in your way, such as asteroids, meteorite showers and aliens who'll try to break your nodes. Magnetic storms and pulsars will change colors, and magnetic spheres will prevent you from using the nodes in the surrounding area. Exceedingly simple to understand but challenging to master, FIZZ is an inventive puzzle challenge that will have gamers on the edge of their seats.

locale.title: Pokémon Sacred Gold
locale.synopsis:
A rebalanced adventure through the Johto region.
For those using Twilight Boxart, the ID of your rom must be changed from IKPE to IKPC using a program like dsbuff. Edited rom may not work, so you would need to take the banner.bin and header.bin from the unpacked edited rom and pack them into an unedited one.

locale.title: TWiLight Menu++
locale.synopsis: TWiLight Menu++ is an open-source DSi Menu upgrade/replacement for the Nintendo DSi, the Nintendo 3DS, and Nintendo DS flashcards. It can launch games for the Nintendo DS, Nintendo DSi, and GameBoy Advance, as well as DSTWO plugins (if you use a DSTWO).
